## Ctx.renderChunked() method

Sends a long template text as sequential chunks using the page template.

Template block: `<g-message>` (read via `getGMessage`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderChunked(keyboard: IInBoKb | null | undefined, data: IData | null | undefined, AGBaseId: string, options?: IOptReply | null, chunkSize?: number): Promise<(grammy_types.Message.CommonMessage & {
        text: string;
    } & Partial<{
        entities: grammy_types.MessageEntity[];
    }>)[]>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;(grammy\_types.Message.CommonMessage &amp; { text: string; } &amp; Partial&lt;{ entities: grammy\_types.MessageEntity\[\]; }&gt;)\[\]&gt;

The sent message objects in order.

## Remarks

Renders the full block FIRST (placeholders never split), then splits deterministically (boundary priority `\n\n` → `\n` → space → hard-cut, pieces trimmed, empties skipped) and sends sequentially with the keyboard ONLY on the last chunk. On mid-loop failure the error is classified, reported to `notifySendError`<!-- -->, stamped with `chunkIndex`<!-- -->, logged, rethrown.

## Example


```typescript
async handleCallbackQueryData() {
  await this.renderChunked(undefined, undefined, `long-card`)
}
```
